testimonials_members.title: Voices of currently active members
testimonials_members.test_1: Diamonds are made under pressure. Nowhere is this truer than at TEG.
testimonials_members.test_2: I was amazed at how much responsibility you get at TEG right from the start, and I've surpassed myself at least five times here.
testimonials_members.test_3: I regularly run marathons because I love challenges and peak performance. That's exactly why I'm at TEG.
